department: School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences

deadline.value: Students are advised to start in September/October; postgraduate research applications are accepted on a rolling basis throughout the year.
deadline.quote: Although we advise students to start in September/October, it's often possible to start postgraduate research at any point in the year. You can state your preferred start date in your application, although this will need to be confirmed by the academic school.

entry_route.value: Academic entry requirements vary by academic school; some subjects require a master's degree, while others accept a good undergraduate degree (2:1 or First).
entry_route.quote: Information about academic entry requirements is available from the school in which your research is based. Entry requirements vary depending on what you study – some subjects require a masters degree, others ask for a good undergraduate degree (a 2:1 or a First).

supervisor.value: Applicants wishing to research their own project idea must contact the academic school before submitting a formal application to ensure an appropriately-qualified supervisor is available.
supervisor.quote: If you want to research your own idea, you should contact the relevant academic school before you submit a formal application, to check that they have an appropriately-qualified supervisor in the area you'd like to study.

funding.value: Funding is competitive through university scholarships, research councils, and school or project-specific studentships.
funding.quote: Schools and supervisors may have funding for specific projects throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test is not stated or required for Physics PhD at Sheffield.

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Physics PhD) in the School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences at the University of Sheffield.
